prompt1_result.diagnosis: Non-small cell lung cancer, Gastric cancer, Gallbladder cancer, Breast cancer, Colon cancer, Cholangiocarcinoma, Pancreatic cancer, Thymic cancer, Cervical squamous cell carcinoma, Bladder cancer
prompt1_result.ICI_name: Sintilimab, Tislelizumab, Pembrolizumab, Toripalimab, Camrelizumab, Clinical trial PD-1 antibody
prompt1_result.irAE_date: Median time from initial immunotherapy to onset: 33.5 days (IQR: 20.3 to 46.8)
prompt1_result.irAE_Symptoms: Chest tightness (50.0%), Palpitation (41.7%), Fatigue (25.0%), Dyspnea (16.7%), Myasthenia/myositis (33.3%), Blepharoptosis (25.0%), Myalgia (8.3%), Asymptomatic (25.0%)
prompt1_result.ECG_start: Aberrant ECG: 9 (75.0%); Specific findings: Sinus tachycardia, Atrial flutter, Ventricular Tachycardia, Sinus bradycardia, Atrioventricular block, Bundle branch block, Cardiac arrest, ST segment elevation, T wave changes, Left anterior branch block, Complete right bundle branch block, III-degree atrioventricular block
prompt1_result.NT-proBNP_value: Elevated BNP: 6 (50.0%); Median at diagnosis: 133.4 pg/ml (range: 31.8–373.5); Specific values: 2750 pg/ml (Case 3), 60.8 pg/ml (Case 4), 31 pg/ml (Case 5)
prompt1_result.CTNI_value: Elevated TnI: 12 (100.0%); Median at diagnosis: 0.6 ng/L (range: 0.12–8.13); Specific values: 0.227 ng/ml (Case 1), 0.84 ng/ml (Case 2), 7.62 ng/ml (Case 3), 23.7 ng/ml (Case 4), 8.3 ng/ml (Case 5)
prompt1_result.CK-MB_value: Elevated CK-MB: 7 (58.3%); Median at diagnosis: 53.4 ng/ml (range: 15.7–77.8); Specific values: >80 U/L (Case 4), 250.4 U/L (Case 5)
prompt1_result.irAE_decrease_or_stop: Immunotherapy discontinued in some cases (e.g., Case 1, 2); Rechallenge in 3 patients (25.0%)
prompt1_result.jisu_ dosage: Varied: 1 mg/kg/day, 2 mg/kg/day, 500-1000 mg/day, 4 mg/kg/day, 240 mg/day
prompt1_result.jisu_regime: Systemic corticosteroids; High-dose for severe cases, oral for subclinical; Duration median 9.0 weeks (range: 4.0–13.0)
prompt1_result.Symptoms_after_jisu_treatment: Improvement: 9 (75.0%); Worse: 3 (25.0%); Specific: TnI dropped to normal range (Case 1), symptom improvement observed (Case 5)
prompt1_result.TNI_value_after_treatment: Median time from initial increased TnI to normal TnI: 34.0 days (IQR: 5.5–72.5); Specific: Normalized in 10 days (Case 1), dropped to normal range in 8 weeks (Case 2)
prompt1_result.CK-MB_value_after_treatment: CK-MB levels rapidly normalized in one month
prompt1_result.Second_line_yzj_dosage: IVIG: 400 mg/kg/day (Case 4); Tacrolimus: dosage not specified
prompt1_result.Symptoms_after_yzj_treatment: Successful treatment with tacrolimus in 1 patient; IVIG added for insufficient improvement (Case 2)
prompt1_result.irAE_outcome: Death: 3 (25.0%); Discharged from hospital: 9 (75.0%); Alive: 8; Died of cardiotoxicity: 3, Died of tumor progression: 1
